model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the loss values for five different models—Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128)—as a function of the number of iterations. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration," ranges from 0 to 140,000 with major tick marks at intervals of 20,000, representing the training iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," ranges from 2.4 to 3.4, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.1, indicating the model's loss. All five lines start at a high loss value of approximately 3.4 at iteration 0 and exhibit a steep decline in the initial iterations, followed by a gradual convergence. The "Vanilla" model (purple) and "StrmLLM (n=64)" (blue) show the highest loss values throughout the training process. The "SepLLM (n=64)" (orange) and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" (red) lines are closely clustered and show slightly lower loss values than the first two, converging to a loss of approximately 2.55 by iteration 140,000. The "SepLLM (n=128)" (dark blue) model demonstrates the lowest loss, starting at the same high value but converging more rapidly and reaching a final loss of approximately 2.52 by iteration 140,000.
